description: PR #185 made claim, read, finality, and rebase identity a Derivation = (Job, DerivationKey). ReturnType still violates that model: ActivationMap stores one mutable return payload per ActivationKey, World resolves its rebase through Job::AnalyzeActivation, and last-claim withdrawal leaves the old payload behind. Make the existing AnalyzeActivation publisher use DerivationKey::Activation and make its ReturnType payload replace, rebase, and clear by that exact derivation. This is a semantic-state migration only; it must preserve current answers before any return-group solver is added. TDD: two activation derivations with independent grounds; move/withdraw one and prove the other has no revision, wake, rebase, allocation, or stored-value change; last-claim withdrawal clears the value before re-claim; unchanged fixture facts and artifacts remain identical. This is required before fz-kdt.177.9 can publish member returns from a canonical group job.
title: ReturnType payload follows its activation derivation
